stories.title: Flintshire loses 290 of its smallest businesses in three years
stories.summary: The number of very small businesses in Flintshire has fallen by 290 in three years, even as the county bucked a Wales-wide drop in established firms. stories.title: Seventeen students awarded black belts at Deeside Taekwondo Academy
stories.summary: Seventeen students at Deeside Taekwondo Academy have been awarded black belts at a recent presentation. Ten of them achieved their first dan, the first black belt grade. stories.summary: Health minister Mabon ap Gwynfor has faced cross-chamber criticism over NHS funding after setting out his strategy to tackle seasonal winter pressures. stories.title: Plan to cut unnecessary traffic in Chester city centre to be reviewed by councillors next week
stories.summary: A radical rethink in how people travel around Chester is set to be reviewed by council chiefs.
